findings.description: No key_policy is specified for the KMS key, which causes AWS to apply the default key policy granting full access (kms:*) to the root account, and combined with any IAM policies granting broad KMS permissions this can allow unintended principals to use or manage the key. Since this key protects audit trail data, an explicit least-privilege key policy should be defined.

The resource does not set enable_key_rotation = true, so automatic annual rotation of the KMS key material is disabled, increasing the risk associated with long-term use of a single key for encrypting sensitive audit data.
